notes: "Start from a situation most researchers know. A good results slide is made once, then copied into every later talk. Each copy is edited separately, so a corrected value or a better figure reaches only one deck. Slide numbers do not help either: slide 7 in the lab version is slide 12 in the conference version. And the reasons behind a layout — which figure must stay, which wording a supervisor approved — are rarely written down. That matters more now that we ask AI agents to edit slides for us: they need the same context a colleague would."
